summary: The role model and enforcement mechanism itself is well-built: the migration is additive and correctly sequenced (0012 following 0011 with no collision), requireRole()/ROLE_GROUPS is a clean, correctly-typed helper that mirrors an existing compliance-tracker pattern, the six gated routes apply the right group (PM_OR_ABOVE vs FIELD) per their domain, the unit tests directly and correctly exercise the new logic, tsc compiles clean, and no .github/workflows/** files were touched. However, the diff has two real gaps that block approval as-is: (1) src/app/api/punch-list/[id]/route.ts's PATCH handler has no requireRole() call at all, while the sibling POST on the same resource is gated to ROLE_GROUPS.FIELD -- any authenticated org member, including the new read-only client_viewer role this same PR introduces, can update/resolve punch-list items even though they cannot create one, which is an inconsistent and almost certainly unintended enforcement hole in the very feature this task targets. (2) There is no in-product way to actually assign the new pm/site_engineer (or client_viewer) roles to a membership row -- GET /api/org-members is read-only and no PATCH/PUT endpoint or settings UI for changing a member's role exists anywhere in the codebase. Since the existing default role is 'member' and 'member' is excluded from both ROLE_GROUPS.PM_OR_ABOVE and ROLE_GROUPS.FIELD, merging this will immediately 403 every existing non-owner/admin user (e.g. anyone currently filing site-diary or punch-list entries under the old, unenforced routes) out of all six gated routes, with no self-serve or admin-facing path to promote them to pm/site_engineer -- only a manual Supabase SQL/MCP edit could fix it. That is a real functional regression risk for live orgs and needs either a companion role-assignment mechanism or an explicit, reviewed remediation plan before this merges, not just enforcement code landing on its own.
issues: src/app/api/punch-list/[id]/route.ts PATCH has no requireRole()/ROLE_GROUPS.FIELD gate, inconsistent with the FIELD-gated POST on src/app/api/punch-list/route.ts in the same PR -- any authenticated member (including client_viewer) can update/resolve punch-list items.

No in-app mechanism (API route or UI) exists to assign the new 'pm'/'site_engineer'/'client_viewer' roles to a membership -- GET /api/org-members is read-only, so merging this locks out all existing 'member'-role users from project-budgets, schedule/baselines, change-orders, purchase-orders, site-diary, and punch-list POST/PATCH with no in-product remediation path.
This diff does not touch .github/workflows/** -- no hard-rule concern to flag.
